cases.name: Refund and unpaid bill
cases.prompt: My grocery budget is $100. I spent $60 and received a $10 grocery refund. A separate unpaid $25 utility bill is due Friday.
expectations: Lists the $25 utility bill as unpaid.
Does not add the unpaid bill to posted spending.

cases.name: Match actual to plan
cases.prompt: My $40 internet bill was due June 5. The June 5 ledger shows its confirmed $40 payment. Give a CSV-ready summary, no bank access.
expectations: Connects the payment to the internet obligation.
Counts $40 of posted spending exactly once.
Returns spreadsheet-ready fields without claiming bank access.

cases.name: Avoid cross-currency total
cases.prompt: This month I spent 30 USD and 20 EUR dining out. Compare to last month's 25 USD with no exchange rate.
expectations: Keeps USD and EUR in separate totals.
Computes a 5 USD difference for comparable USD spending.
Identifies the missing rate for an all-in comparison.
